name: Asakura Yuki
source:
[url=/c4054]Yume[/url] and [url=/c4053]Otome's[/url] mother who died three month after [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url] was adopted into their family.

[spoiler]She is from a family of magicians which has lived for many generations. This fact explains why Otome is an magician. Her maiden name is Katsuragi.[/spoiler]
